market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is ~$101.79 May 4 with prices having spiked above $105 then receded. A LOW of $95 in May requires only ~6.7% pullback — not unusual within a high-vol month, especially if US-Iran ceasefire firms up and Hormuz reopens. Some downside trading is also typical for a single day spike-and-fade.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether geopolitical premium holds keeping spot above $95 entirely.
